sentences.en: It was a daring adventure, full of thrill and excitement.
sentences.zh: 这是一次大胆的冒险，充满了刺激和兴奋。

sentences.en: It was his story of adventure that charmed us all.
sentences.zh: 是他讲述的冒险故事让我们都着迷了。

sentences.en: The adventures I read about are absent from my life.
sentences.zh: 我读过的那些冒险故事在我的生活中从未出现过。

senses.zh: 冒险活动；冒险经历；奇遇 - 冒险，刺激 -
